summary: Frontend-only verification completed for footer alignment bugfix and related footer regressions on desktop/mobile preview URL.
critical_code_review_comments: App.css defines .footer-label in two separate blocks (early and near footer section), creating style override coupling and maintainability risk; consider consolidating into one scoped rule set.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Validated on https://micro-moments-8.preview.emergentagent.com using browser automation. Confirmed: My Philosophy label left-aligned with heading block, heading rendered as 3 line spans, label stays single-line, description visible, Behance/Email links visible, no horizontal overflow on desktop (1920x1080) and mobile (390x844).
rca of the issue: Original misalignment was caused by inherited centered label behavior (shared label class with auto-centered margins). Current fix works by resetting footer label margins and left text alignment, then scoping bottom margin in .footer-philosophy .footer-label.
